goal: agcli-subtensor-audit: agcli is a full SDK and CLI tooling for agents to do everything that can be done on the subtensor blockchain (in this repo under subtensor). There are a large number of commands that can be called that perform operations on that chain and agcli is meant to be the interface for an agent to 1) learn how all of them work 2) get outputs from the chain in a consistent and understandable way 3) get docs from the chain when it is confused. Any operation that you can perceive is possible on subtensor should be possible through agcli without error. It must also be available for perfect use to sign operations with wallets, create hotkeys, register subnets, set hyperparams, set weights, register miners, etc. All of this can be enumerated by reading the code and IMPORTANTLY: understanding the code. Break this task up into 100s of independently running agents which mine agcli + subtensor to find discrepancies, badly displayed information, non-usable functions, ill-documented functions, things that are done wrong (i.e. not formatted semantically), failing tests, missed arguments, missed functions. Each agent will break down a section of the code, find the corresponding agcli input, think about how it can be used, think about how to document it, test it, run a green path for it, ensure that it works on a subtensor localnet clone. Each agent should make heavy use of running a mock local chain (see scaffold), creating state on the chain, then testing their specific operations to make sure that agcli is working as expected. Run this with maximum parallelism.
summary: audit agcli against every subtensor extrinsic; ~32 workers, one per command group + cross-cutting module, each producing docs + green-path tests + findings
acceptanceCriteria: Every CLI command group has an audit handoff with concrete findings.
Every CLI command group has a tests/audit_<group>.rs file that at minimum compiles and asserts the clap parse surface.
Every docs/commands/<group>.md file accurately describes every subcommand it covers.
Verifier handoffs confirm `cargo check --bin agcli` and `cargo build --bin agcli` succeed on each merged batch.
